From $26,000+ to zero 💔💔💔

I have had one of my most painful experiences since I started trading 😭💔

Yesterday (27 November 2026), I took a trade on XAUUSD immediately after the Asian session, before the London session opened, which was exactly at 4:58 am UTC+1. It was a long position, and I was targeting 590 pips.

The trade started moving immediately, and by the end of the London session, the trade was around my TP. 
Then came the painful experience.

Gold started consolidating for a while at my TP zone, but I wasn’t bothered because I knew my take profit zone was kind of okay since it’s an ERL and there’s a 1H IRL that could drive the price even higher from that zone.

At the peak of my trade, I was up: 
• $24,000+ on my @tradeifyforex $250k phase 2 account 
• $800+ on my @THEFUNDEDWAY $25k Funded account 
• $600+ on my @EvercrestFunds $25k Funded account 
• $1,000+ on my two @FundedNext $25k challenge accounts

Then, the New York session opened, and gold started selling aggressively, which I wasn’t bothered about because there was a 4H FVG that I thought gold would retrace and fill before continuing its upward movement. Little did I know that I was about to lose everything and more 😭💔

The trade hit my SL, and then something inside me started whispering in my ear, “This trade will still go up, enter again.” And I made the decision, due to the pain I was feeling, that I should take revenge, which I did.

I entered a revenge trade immediately, and the trade went to my SL immediately. I entered again, and the same thing happened (SL) 🤦‍♂️🤦. That’s when I realized that I fvcked up badly, and now the accounts are sitting at -3% each.

It’s a bad experience, but I’m not pained about the trade that never hit my TP, but rather the revenge trades I entered due to emotional stress and FOMO. But I learned my lesson.

Next time, if something like this happens, I will immediately close my phone and go for a walk. I will make sure I distance myself from my device so I can get back to normal and think once again.

MISTAKE MADE 
LESSON LEARNED 
UNTO THE NEXT 👊

300/300🔥

Done and Dusted!🐦‍🔥

On the 1st of February 2026, I decided that I was going to change the trajectory of my life in 300 days.

I was frustrated. I wanted to become a great trader, but I couldn’t seem to find anyone to properly guide me. I had paid for multiple mentorships that ended up being futile, and quite frankly, I was tired of the financial state I was in.

So I decided to take matters into my own hands.

I committed to 300 days of consistently studying the charts, documenting my journey, sharing what I learned and holding myself accountable publicly.

I think only two people attended my very first class. 😂

Today, 300 days later:

• I’ve built a Telegram community of about 2,000 people.

• I’ve held classes every single day for 300 days, averaging 40 attendees every night, with some nights having 60 to 70 people who stayed throughout the class.

• I’ve consistently created content and grown a community of about 12,000 people on TikTok and over 8,000 on X.

• I’ve passed prop firm accounts, received payouts and secured brand deals.

But goodness, the amount of work that went into this.

I held classes in Ubers and by the roadside. There were nights when I literally walked across multiple streets looking for decent network coverage just so I could hold a class.

I’d be at a family function or a work event, and once it was 8 p.m., I’d excuse myself, find a corner somewhere and hold my class.

I held classes while sick, even from the hospital while receiving IV infusions.

It got to a point where everyone around me understood how serious I was about this challenge. My friends, my family, everyone. My close friends knew better than to call me between 8 and 10 p.m. That time was practically non-negotiable.

For a significant part of this challenge, I was juggling four other jobs, managing my personal brand and navigating other commitments. Life was lifeing in every possible sense.

Crazy work, when I think about it now. 😂

Yet, every single day, I found a way to show up.

But beyond my personal achievements, perhaps the most beautiful thing to come out of these 300 days is the success of the people who did this with me.

People received payouts. People passed different phases of their prop firm evaluations. A lot of people who had previously struggled with trading became profitable during the challenge.

It’s particularly beautiful to me because one of the reasons I started this challenge was the frustration of not having the guidance I needed.

And somehow, in trying to find my own way, I became part of the reason other people found theirs.

If you had told me on February 1st that this would be the outcome of my little consistency challenge, I probably wouldn’t have believed you.

To everyone who spent their evenings learning with me, trusted me, encouraged me, held me accountable and allowed me to be a part of their trading journey, thank you.

I started this challenge because I wanted a better life for myself. I am ending it knowing that my decision to pursue one also made a difference in the lives of others.

And that, to me, makes every single one of those 300 days worth it.

For someone who is constantly thinking about the next goal, the next milestone and the next thing to accomplish, I really want to give myself a moment to celebrate this one.

I kept a promise I made to myself 300 days ago, regardless of what life looked like on any given day.

I DID THAT.

And I am so incredibly proud of myself. ❤️
